rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=123, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-7: ONE knob -> seed 42 -> 123 (per-image N2I noise-floor read). CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE. KEEP lr=1e-4 (per-scan overfit anchor, iter-3 winner) and RESET pretrain_epochs 18 -> 12 (the PEAK, not ep18). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): the init lever (warm-start pretrain_epochs) climbed then SATURATED AND TURNED OVER -- iter-3 ep3 0.4880; iter-4 ep6 0.4957 (+0.0077); iter-5 ep12 0.5081 (+0.0124, PSNR 16.376, the PEAK); iter-6 ep18 0.5016 (-0.0065, PSNR 16.29 -- DID NOT beat ep12). The iter-5/iter-6 falsifier FIRED: more init budget past ep12 no longer helps (over-converges the amortized warm-start pre-pass / the per-scan lr=1e-4 fit cannot exploit a noisier init), so the init axis is EXHAUSTED. n_iter is RULED OUT (iter-2 1200 steps REGRESSED 0.4785->0.4293, per-scan U-Net overfits one noisy scan) and unet_c is the explicitly-warned-against axis (solver design doc: capacity is NOT the lever for this loss; mayo n2i c16->c32 flat 0.9508). FAILURE MODE = per-image U-Net N2I has converged to its structural ceiling (~0.51 SSIM, hr~0) on this 128-view synthetic-phantom substrate; the 0.5081<->0.5016 swing between the two best inits is within noise, not a real lever. LEVER CHOICE (a NOT-yet-tried axis): of seed / grad_clip / unet_c-retest, pick SEED. seed=42 was FIXED across all 6 prior iters, so the per-image noise floor is unmeasured; flipping seed 42->123 at the PEAK config (ep12, lr1e-4, n_iter600) re-randomizes the warm-start init + the angular-subset split + Adam init, giving a clean read of how much of the 0.5081<->0.5016 swing is stochastic. grad_clip=1.0 is LOAD-BEARING (the 128-view FBP adjoint guard -- mandatory per campaign-state, do NOT touch) and unet_c is warned-against, so seed is the safest, most-informative ceiling-doc probe. HYPOTHESIS: at seed=123/ep12/lr1e-4 the SSIM lands within ~+/-0.01 of the 0.5081 ep12 peak (i.e. inside the 0.5016<->0.5081 band), confirming ~0.51 is the per-image U-Net N2I ceiling on demo and that the ep18 dip was noise, not a real init turn-over. hr stays 0 (structurally FBP-bounded on dense-view phantoms -- the U-Net overfits one scan where the bilateral twin's 6 params cannot, which is why the twin clears baseline at hr+0.33). FALSIFIER: if SSIM jumps >0.52 or drops <0.49 the per-image fit is seed-sensitive (large noise floor) and the ~0.51 ceiling claim needs a seed average before being called converged. Toward iter-20 this DOCUMENTS the ~0.51 per-image U-Net N2I ceiling on the synthetic 128-view substrate -- the structurally-hardest run (synthetic substrate, U-Net overfits, hr stays 0). WALL: warm 12x200=2400 + per-image 6x600=3600 = 6000 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 500 s (iter-5 was 463 s at the same 6000-step budget), under the 15-min target, the outer_wall_s=1200 guard, and the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall. All other knobs IDENTICAL to the iter-5 PEAK config (train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, lr=1e-4, unet_c=16); ONLY seed 42->123 changed.
